app.name: Garden Designer
app.loadError: This part of the app couldn’t be loaded. Check your internet connection and reload the page.

appUpdate.available: A new version of the app is available.

projects.title: Your garden designs
projects.emptyHint: Create a new design, or import a .garden.json file.
projects.storageError: Your designs couldn't be loaded. This browser may be blocking local storage, for example in a private window.

errors.generic: Something went wrong and the change wasn’t made. Please try again.
errors.importNotJson: This file couldn’t be read as a garden design.
errors.importNotGardenFile: This file isn’t a Garden Designer design (.garden.json).
errors.importNewerVersion: This design was made with a newer version of the app. Reload the page to update the app, then try again.
errors.importInvalid: This design file is damaged or incomplete.

canvas.label: Garden plan
canvas.emptyHint: Start with the plot: import a site plan to trace over, draw the outline (P) or create a rectangle (R).
canvas.traceHint: Trace the plot over the site plan: press P and click its corners.

library.title: Plant library
library.noResults: No plants match. Try another name or fewer filters.
library.noCustom: No plants of your own yet. Add one with “New plant”, or copy a plant from the library.
library.unverifiedHint: These details haven’t been checked yet.

detail.soilDry: Grows on sand, but isn’t drought tolerant: water it in dry spells.
detail.copyHint: For a variety with other colours or sizes.
detail.deleteConfirmUsed_one: Delete “{{name}}” and the {{count}} plant of it on the plan?
detail.deleteConfirmUsed_other: Delete “{{name}}” and the {{count}} plants of it on the plan?

form.namesHint: At least one name; the Latin name is shown in italics.
form.spreadHint: For a climber: the width it covers. For a hedging plant: the width of the hedge.
form.flowerColorsHint: The first colour you pick is the one shown on the plan.

errors.name: Enter at least one name.
errors.height: Enter a height greater than 0, up to 100 m.
errors.spread: Enter a width greater than 0, up to 50 m.
errors.years: Enter a number of years greater than 0, up to 100.
errors.spacing: Enter a spacing greater than 0, up to 10 m.

properties.title: Properties
properties.hint: Click an item on the plan to select it. Shift-click adds to the selection.
properties.label: Label

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.clearSelection: Clear selection / stop drawing or calibrating
shortcuts.shiftClick: Add to or remove from the selection

drawing.hintStart: Click on the plan to place the first corner.
drawing.hintNext: Click the next corner, or type a length (and angle) and press Enter.
drawing.hintFinish: Add more corners, or press Enter or click the first corner to finish.
drawing.keys: Angle: 0° = right, 90° = up. Backspace removes the last corner, Esc cancels, hold Alt to turn off snapping.
drawing.invalidLength: Enter a length greater than 0, e.g. 12,5.
drawing.invalidAngle: Enter an angle in degrees, e.g. 90.
drawing.needStart: Click on the plan first to place the starting corner.
drawing.needMoreCorners: A plot needs at least 3 corners.

plot.title: Plot boundary
plot.selfIntersecting: The outline crosses itself, so the area is not reliable. Move a corner to fix it.
plot.cornerHint: Drag a corner to move it. Click a corner to select it (Delete removes it). Drag or click the dot on an edge to add a corner.
plot.minCorners: A plot needs at least 3 corners.

rectangle.title: Rectangular plot
rectangle.invalid: Enter a width and depth greater than 0.
rectangle.note: You can move and add corners afterwards.
rectangle.replaces: Replaces the current plot outline (undo with Ctrl+Z).

calibration.hintStart: Calibrate the scale: click the start of a distance you know, such as a dimensioned edge on the site plan.
calibration.hintDistance: Type the real distance and press Enter.
calibration.keys: Zoom in to click precisely. Clicking again starts a new line; Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels.
calibration.invalidDistance: Enter a distance greater than 0, e.g. 12,5.
calibration.needPoints: First click both ends of the distance on the plan.
calibration.tooShort: The two points are too close together. Zoom in and click them again.

sitePlan.title: Site plan
sitePlan.importHint: Trace your plot over a site plan, cadastral map or aerial photo (PDF, PNG or JPG).
sitePlan.pagesHint: {{file}} has {{count}} pages. Which one shows the site plan?

errors.unsupported: This type of file can’t be used. Choose a PDF, PNG, JPG or WebP file.
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large. Use a file of at most 100 MB, or save the page as an image first.
errors.unreadable: This file couldn’t be read. It may be damaged; try saving the page as a PNG or JPG.
errors.pdfPassword: This PDF is protected with a password. Save a copy without a password, or as an image.
errors.saveFailed: The image couldn’t be saved in the browser. The storage may be full. Export a backup to be safe.
errors.storageFull: The browser’s storage is full, so the image couldn’t be saved. Export backups of your designs and remove designs or site plans you no longer need, or use a smaller image.

sitePlan.notCalibrated: Not calibrated yet, so its size is a guess. Calibrate the scale before you trace.
sitePlan.alignHint: Drag the image to move it (arrow keys for small steps) and turn it with the round handle. A positive angle turns anticlockwise.
sitePlan.lockHint: So it can’t move by accident while you trace

beds.needMoreCorners: A bed needs at least 3 corners.
beds.minCorners: A bed needs at least 3 corners.
beds.name: Name
beds.selfIntersecting: The outline crosses itself, so the area is not reliable. Move a corner to fix it.
beds.fillHint: To fill this bed, open a plant in the library and choose “Fill bed”.
beds.cornerHint: Drag a corner to move it, or click it to select it (Delete removes it). Drag or click the dot on an edge to add a corner.

placing.title: Put on the plan
placing.dragHint: Drag onto the plan to place it.
placing.onPlan_one: {{count}} on the plan. Drag onto the plan to place another.
placing.onPlan_other: {{count}} on the plan. Drag onto the plan to place another.
placing.stampHint: click on the plan to place a plant, as often as you like. Esc stops.
placing.fillBed: {{bed}}. Change the spacing if you like, then press Enter or “Fill bed”. Click another bed to fill that one.
placing.invalidSpacing: Enter a spacing between 0,05 and 50 m.
placing.tooMany: That would be more than {{max}} plants. Use a larger spacing.
placing.noRoom: No room for this plant at this spacing (or the bed is full).
placing.rowHintFinish: Add more points, or press Enter to plant the row.
placing.rowNeedsPoints: A row needs a start and an end point.
placing.labelCodes: Label plants with codes instead of names

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.thresholdHint: Plants overlap when they do by more than {{percent}} of the smaller one at full size (design settings).
warnings.thresholdHintYear: Plants overlap when they do by more than {{percent}} of the smaller one at their size in {{year}} (design settings).
warnings.soilDryOne: Isn’t drought tolerant, and sand dries out: water it in dry spells.

plantingList.title: Planting list
plantingList.empty: No plants on the plan yet. Drag one from the library.
plantingList.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Your browser may not allow it.

view.label: View
view.yearHint: Show the plants at their size in a year after planting. Plants that go in later are drawn faint, with a dashed outline.
view.monthHint: Show how the plants look in a month: in flower, in leaf, in autumn colour or bare.

bloomChart.title: Bloom chart
bloomChart.caption: Flowering plants per month
bloomChart.empty: No flowering plants in the design yet.
bloomChart.emptyBed: No flowering plants in this bed yet.
bloomChart.allMonths: Something is in bloom every month.

settings.title: Design settings
settings.name: Name
settings.soilHint: Plants that don’t suit the soil get a warning.
settings.invalidGrid: Enter a grid size between 0,01 and 100 m.
settings.overlapHint: Two plants get a warning when, at full size, they overlap by more than this share of the smaller plant’s width.

storage.full: The browser’s storage is full, so this couldn’t be saved. Export backups of your designs, then delete designs you no longer need.
storage.autosaveFull: The browser’s storage is full, so your latest changes aren’t saved yet. They stay here while this page is open, and saving is tried again with your next change. Export a backup now, then delete designs or site plans you no longer need.
storage.autosaveFailed: Your latest changes couldn’t be saved in the browser. They stay here while this page is open, and saving is tried again with your next change. Export a backup now; if this keeps happening, delete designs or site plans you no longer need.
storage.exportFailed: The backup couldn’t be made. Keep this page open and try again.
storage.leaveUnsaved: Your latest changes aren’t saved. If you leave now, they’ll be lost. Leave anyway?
